title: Order status summary string
statementMd:
For each status, produce one text value like `delivered: 10` using `||`. Name the column `summary`.

Expected columns: `summary`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Concatenate with `||`; cast the count as needed.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT status || ': ' || COUNT(*) AS summary FROM orders GROUP BY status;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
